name: terraform-plan
label: Terraform Plan
description: Compact `terraform plan` output. Strips Refreshing state lines and lock chatter; preserves the Plan summary and resource diffs.

matchOutput.pattern: No changes\.\s*Your infrastructure matches the configuration\.

tests.name: strips-refreshing-and-blank-lines
tests.input:
Acquiring state lock. This may take a few moments...
Refreshing state... [id=vpc-abc]
Refreshing state... [id=sg-123]

Plan: 1 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy.
tests.expected:
Acquiring state lock. This may take a few moments...
Plan: 1 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy.
